CheckTitle: Ensure Amazon S3 Buckets Do Not Allow Public Access
Description: Bucket corp-finance-public-export is publicly accessible to all internet users.
Risk: Data breach, unauthorized data exposure, regulatory non-compliance.

Recommendation.Text: Enable Block Public Access at the bucket level.

CheckTitle: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22
Description: Security group sg-0123456789abcdef0 allows inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22.
Risk: Brute-force SSH attacks, unauthorized system compromise.

Recommendation.Text: Remove rule with CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 or restrict to VPN/Bastion IP.
